svg.text: One customer-service scenario, three ways to ask

g.text: Ten thousand user conversations you want to automate
Three ways of asking give three different products and bills
Label "which flow each message should take", and train a triage model
Humans must label; new flows need fresh labels; accurate, but only inside flows it has seen
No labels; let the machine cluster the conversations on its own
No labelling cost; but the clusters may come out by "greeting length" rather than by "problem type"
Let the bot answer live, with "satisfied user/handoff" as the score
No labels, straight for the objective; but live trial and error really does offend users

svg.text: And there is a further branch: self-supervision——the data supplies its own answers (predict the next word from what came before). It belongs to the unsupervised family but is the most powerful of them - see 1.5 1.5.
